nearest.text: 1. Maximum Feret diameter ( d F max )—the longest distance between two parallel lines
tangential to the 2D silhouette of the granule as observed in the imaging plane. It
provides an estimate of the granule’s largest dimension in the image plane. Formally,
d F max = max θ ∈ [ 0, π ) d F ( θ ) , (1)
where d F ( θ ) > 0 represents the distance between two distinct parallel lines at an angle
θ to the x -axis that are tangents of the granule’s 2D silhouette.
